original.description: Autochrome portrait of General Paul Pau, made at Boulogne on 20 May 1920 by Auguste Léon for Albert Kahn’s Archives de la Planète. An original colour photograph, not a colorization.
original.archive: Musée Albert-Kahn, Archives de la Planète, via Wikimedia Commons

colorization.status: not colorized, and must not be — this is an original colour photograph (autochrome). Reproduce as it is; any colour change would falsify a documentary colour record.

caption: General Paul Pau, who commanded the improvised Army of Alsace in August 1914. An autochrome of 1920 — a colour photograph of the period, not a colorization.
credit: Original photograph: Auguste Léon, Boulogne, 20 May 1920; Musée Albert-Kahn, Archives de la Planète; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. Pau lost his right arm in 1870 — a detail worth keeping in frame when the focal point is set. Valuable to the pack as documentary colour: it lets the UI show a real 1914-era colour photograph beside the project’s own colorizations.
